proof.title: Where dis numbers come from

proof.edge: Every request wey go dehub.io dey pass through Cloudflare before e reach our servers. Dis counts na Cloudflare own aggregation of dat traffic — di same figures our dashboard dey show. Dem no dey collect am by any script for your browser, so nothing for dis page fit inflate am, and blocking trackers no dey change am.
proof.live: Di page dey read am live. Loading /stats dey call our endpoint, wey dey query Cloudflare Analytics API for dat moment and cache di answer for 60 seconds.

Anybody wey get dem own Cloudflare zone fit run di same query against am and confirm di shape.

definitions.title: Wetin di numbers mean
definitions.visitors: — unique IP addresses wey Cloudflare see dat day. E close to people, but no be exactly di same: office wey dey on one connection count once, and phone wey dey move between wifi and mobile data count twice.
definitions.pageViews: — requests wey Cloudflare classify as page loads, no be images, scripts or API calls.
definitions.bots: — dis one na raw edge counts, so crawlers, uptime monitors and scripted clients dey inside am. You fit see am yourself for di browser breakdown wey dey up top, where entries like "Curl" and "Unknown" na automated traffic instead of people. To filter bots out need paid Cloudflare tier wey we no dey run, and if we quietly subtract estimate, e go make di numbers harder to check, no be easier.
definitions.total: — page views and requests dey add up across di range. Visitor counts no dey sum join for one headline "total visitors" on purpose, because person wey dey here Monday and Tuesday go count twice.
definitions.peak: — di highest unique count for any single bucket for di range, for di same reason: na figure wey Cloudflare really measure, no be one wey dem build by adding counts wey dey overlap.
definitions.resolution: — dat one na Cloudflare limit for dis plan, no be choice: e dey refuse any hourly query wey wide pass three days. Di 24-hour and 3-day views dey hourly; 7 days and beyond dey daily, and no way dey to draw hourly all-time chart.
definitions.breakdown: — dis one dey follow di range wey you pick, but e only dey go back {{max}} days, na so far di per-day breakdown dey keep am. For longer range, di chart cover more time pass di country list.
definitions.start: — "all time" mean every day wey Cloudflare still keep, wey today na {{days}} days starting {{date}}, di day wey dehub.io move go Cloudflare. No earlier edge data dey to show, and old days dey drop off as Cloudflare dey age dem out.
definitions.estimated: — since {{date}}, dehub.io dey pass through one relay server so dat network wey no fit reach Cloudflare direct fit still load di site. So Cloudflare dey see most visitors as di relay one address, and im unique count go fall well-well. For dose days, di chart dey show di page views wey we measure, multiply by di normal visitors-per-page-view ratio of di {{days}} days before ({{ratio}}%). Page views and requests still dey measured direct, and Cloudflare own count wey nobody touch dey inside di raw response wey we link for up.
